name: mocked_sut_spyon
description: Test spies on SUT function via its module namespace and configures mock return value, asserting the mocked return
test_pattern: import * as orderService from '../src/order-service'; describe('createOrder') { jest.spyOn(orderService, 'createOrder').mockResolvedValue({ status: 'cancelled', fulfillmentPublished: false }); const res = await orderService.createOrder({ id: 'o-2', total: 50 }, deps); expect(res).toEqual({ status: 'cancelled', fulfillmentPublished: false }); }

name: call_only_charge_assertion
description: Test invokes SUT function with mocked boundary dependency but only asserts that the mock dependency was called

name: ambiguous_passthrough_mock_echo
description: Test asserts that SUT output matches mock return value where SUT acts as a passthrough forwarder
test_pattern: const expected = { status: 'approved' }; deps.paymentClient.charge.mockResolvedValue(expected); expect(await getPaymentResult(10, deps)).toBe(expected);

name: no_assertion_void_execution
description: Test executes SUT with input parameters and mock dependencies but contains no expect assertions, thrown error checks, or promise rejections
test_pattern: const deps = makeDeps(); deps.paymentClient.charge.mockResolvedValue({ status: 'approved' }); await createOrder({ id: 'o-1', total: 100 }, deps);

name: valid_failed_payment_boundary_mock
description: Test mocks external paymentClient to fail, invokes real SUT, and asserts cancelled status and negative side-effect on fulfillment publisher
test_pattern: deps.paymentClient.charge.mockResolvedValue({ status: 'failed' }); const res = await createOrder({ id: 'o-3', total: 100 }, deps); expect(res.status).toBe('cancelled'); expect(deps.fulfillment.publish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

name: valid_success_boundary_mock
description: Test mocks external paymentClient to succeed, invokes real SUT, and asserts confirmed status and positive side-effect on fulfillment publisher
test_pattern: deps.paymentClient.charge.mockResolvedValue({ status: 'approved' }); const res = await createOrder({ id: 'o-4', total: 100 }, deps); expect(res.status).toBe('confirmed'); expect(deps.fulfillment.publish).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ orderId: 'o-4' });

name: aliased_sut_import_mock
description: SUT is imported under local alias 'import * as orderModule from ...; const { createOrder: makeOrder } = orderModule' and spied upon via the module namespace
test_pattern: import * as orderModule from '../src/order-service'; describe('aliased', () => { jest.spyOn(orderModule, 'createOrder').mockResolvedValue({ status: 'cancelled', fulfillmentPublished: false }); const { createOrder: makeOrder } = orderModule; const res = await makeOrder({ id: 'o-7', total: 100 }, deps); expect(res.status).toBe('cancelled'); });

name: helper_wrapped_interaction_assertion
description: Test delegates its verification to an in-repo helper function that executes only call-shape assertions on the mock
test_pattern: await createOrder({ id: 'o-8', total: 100 }, deps); verifyClientCalled(deps.paymentClient); // helper contains only expect(client.charge).toHaveBeenCalled()

name: unresolved_computed_mock_target
description: Test configures mock using dynamic property computation or variable access that cannot be statically resolved

name: unsupported_dynamic_resolution
description: Test executes target via runtime eval, reflection, or dynamically generated module require/import
test_pattern: const mod = await import(dynamicPath); await mod[fnName]();
